prompt_construction.text: A GPU executes many threads in parallel. Threads read data from memory, perform arithmetic, and write their results. Efficient inference reuses cached keys and values while generating one new token at a time.
prompt_construction.method: Repeat tokenized phrase, truncate to exact requested length; single fixed prompt per shape

measurement_scope.normal_generation: Synchronized wall time around generate; no added per-step instrumentation. Includes host validation, prefill, decode, argmax, concatenation and fresh cache allocation. Excludes model loading, tokenization and initial prompt transfer. EOS disabled; cache enabled for both variants.
measurement_scope.diagnostic: Separate runs synchronize each step. Prefill includes model forward, first-token argmax and append. Decode includes forward, argmax and append per subsequent token. Cache allocation is outside phase timers. These are diagnostic phase latencies, not streaming TTFT/ITL or pure GPU kernel times; they must not be summed to estimate normal generation latency.
measurement_scope.memory: Exact tensor storage bytes for KV buffers and returned prefill logits, not peak device memory or measured total-memory savings.
measurement_scope.comparison: Same checkpoint, device, dtype, prompt, output length and cache; only last_token_only differs. Order alternates within paired repeats and across cases. Small samples, no confidence-interval or tail-latency claims.
